designResolutions.formatEnum: OfficeDocumentFormat; no OfficeFormat enum is introduced.

designResolutions.frontDoorTarget: OfficeIMO, its batch engine, OfficeIMO.Workflows and OfficeIMO.Workflows.IWork target netstandard2.0, net8.0 and net10.0, plus net472 through the existing Windows-only project condition (approved c526a10ad2). Modern-only route engines are conditionally referenced and registered.
designResolutions.frameworks: Superseded by the approved c526a10ad2 design: retain netstandard2.0, net8.0, net10.0 and the original Windows-only net472 declaration; modern-only packages retain their original targets. Front door and Workflows gain the full set, with explicitly conditional modern engines.
designResolutions.modernAnalysis: Directory.Build.targets enables IsAotCompatible, EnableTrimAnalyzer and EnableAotAnalyzer for packable production library builds targeting net8.0/net10.0. Qualification remains in progress; older targets do not enable those analyzers.

phaseA.scope: Package boundaries, target frameworks, lifecycle, options, conversions and names.

extraChanges.subject: Publication policy ownership
extraChanges.note: IOfficeWorkflowPublicationGuard and IOfficeWorkflowStagingGuard move to Core as IOfficePublicationGuard and IOfficeStagingGuard, keeping host ownership checks available to both the front door and workflows without a dependency cycle.

extraChanges.subject: Orchestration migration boundary
extraChanges.note: Conversion batches, saved definitions, output profiles/limits/publication policy and guarded resource/publication helpers move to their shared owners. Non-conversion workflow operations retain their owning engines. Tier 2 route registration and all host migrations remain in progress.

extraChanges.subject: Framework registration conflict
extraChanges.note: The revised requirement keeps the front door, batch engine and both Workflows libraries on the full framework set. Registration stays in Workflows; modern-only engine references and routes are conditional. No separate assembly is introduced.

extraChanges.subject: Older-framework publishing dates
extraChanges.note: DateOnly does not exist on netstandard2.0 or net472. ONIX publishing date options use System.DateTime on these targets and DateOnly on net8.0/net10.0. Calendar-date serialization and date-valued usage limits reject a nonzero time component. No external date polyfill is introduced.

extraChanges.subject: Conditional standards validation
extraChanges.note: Invoicing.Validation is referenced only on net8.0/net10.0. Validator parameters and standards-report properties are compiled only there. Invoice model inspection, conversion, editing and PDF rendering remain on every target; requesting standards validation on an older target fails closed without returning output.

extraChanges.subject: Tier 1 workflow owner
extraChanges.note: The workflow runner delegates Tier 1 document conversions to OfficeConverter instead of retaining duplicate import and serialization paths. Existing non-conversion workflows retain their engines.

extraChanges.subject: Tier 2 registration
extraChanges.note: OfficeWorkflow.RegisterConversions registers its additional engines in OfficeConverter. OfficeWorkflowRouteSettings captures adapter-owned options; internal checkpoint and output-validation contracts preserve configuration hashes and encrypted artifact reopen checks.

extraChanges.subject: Shared registration settings
extraChanges.note: IOfficeWorkflowConversionSettings merges into OfficeIMO.IOfficeConversionSettings. Workflows and iWork register through OfficeConverter, retaining the existing scoped directory-package snapshots and source verification. Built-in Workflows route fingerprints include FailOnLoss; iWork registrations retain their existing ordinary-batch-only checkpoint boundary.

extraChanges.subject: PowerShell payload references
extraChanges.note: PSWriteOffice retains net8.0 for PowerShell 7.4+ and net472 for Windows PowerShell 5.1. Its project references the front door and both Workflows libraries on both targets now that those owners support net472. Foundation code, format/type metadata, manifest and build loader remain outside this change.

extraChanges.subject: Completed conversion ownership and consumer grammar
extraChanges.note: Removed conversion factories and conversion-only builder members, conversion batch executor/contracts/builder and saved-job/run serializers/runners after moving behavior to OfficeConverter and OfficeBatchOptions/Report. OfficeWorkflowRequest uses shared OfficeConversionOptions; native rendering settings are internal. Tier2 fingerprinting remains without a second batch engine; Tier1 preserves advanced shared options and delegates to OfficeConverter.

extraChanges.change: Batch and saved-job tests now exercise the shared OfficeIMO owner, v2 schemas, native diagnostic fields, real publication guards and progress callbacks. Narrow internal executor access retains staged-output, cancellation, lease and hash-verification regression proof without exposing test plumbing publicly.
extraChanges.reason: Removed Workflows conversion builders, batch executor and saved-job runner are no longer separate supported entry points.

extraChanges.change: Registered route failures carry catalog diagnostics for invalid requests, missing/unsupported inputs and failed outputs. The CLI selects its existing exit codes from these shared codes rather than losing classification when result pairs become throwing conversions.
extraChanges.reason: The new throwing route bridge must preserve the failure category previously carried by OfficeWorkflowResult.

extraChanges.note: Registered conversions retain successful native readback as the catalog conversion-output-reopened diagnostic in the shared report. Apple batch tests use OfficeConverter/OfficeBatchOptions with per-operation IWorkWorkflowSettings rather than the deleted runner batch overload.

Tier 1 forwards shared source import reports as import diagnostics, retains output failure evidence and recognizes shared bounded-output markers. Registered routes retain additional owner diagnostics such as reviewed EPUB import omissions. Existing consumers use the new settings clone, report schema and canonical API names.
Saved job review remains reachable in Studio compact navigation: a loaded folder review selects its Queue tab. Existing mouse-driven retry tests and rendered screenshots cover compact and wide views.

Shared PDF serialization output-limit markers use the existing OutputFailed workflow classification for optimization and sanitization, consistent with other bounded output paths. Tests retain no-publication and exact limit-message checks. Reverse-adapter diagnostic producers use OfficeIMO.Pdf.Word.

applicationStatus: Phase A applied and validated on the supported macOS targets. Phase B and Tier 2 entries retain their status; Windows .NET Framework validation remains pending.
authority: Docs/officeimo.api-design.md, including the c526a10ad2 framework decision; the approved design overrides M0 open questions.

questionResolutions.conversionForms: Source.ToTarget, source.SaveAsTarget and OfficeConversionReport; async ToTarget returns OfficeConversionResult<T>. ToHtml returns string. No static From factories.
questionResolutions.frameworks: No framework is dropped in 3.6. Original library TFMs and Windows net472 conditions remain; the front door and both Workflows projects support the full set. Modern-only engines stay conditional.
questionResolutions.packageDirection: Word.Pdf and PowerPoint.Pdf export native documents. Reverse reconstruction is Pdf.Word and Pdf.PowerPoint; Excel reconstruction is Pdf.Excel. Word page images live in Word.Pdf.
questionResolutions.surface: Markdown syntax nodes are exempt from the format prefix. OfficeColor/OfficeColorRole use the root OfficeIMO namespace. Authoring, units, image-builder consolidation, visibility baselines and AOT smoke acceptance are Phase B.
